learn-head.title: Lessons
learn-head.body: Short lessons you play in the browser, on real market data, in three steps. Every number is computed and the losing years stay in. No sign in needed; signed in, University keeps your place and adds a check.

step-1.title: Step 1: backtest and arm
step-1.body: Arm your AI with our data, read your first rule on the S&P 500 since 2000, then drive the backtester and read the scoreboard.

step-2.title: Step 2: connect and deploy
step-2.body: Your own code at your own broker, with a 30-day paper window if you want it. University teaches it to members: QuantGPT in your own code, and QuantGPT Cloud on QuantGPT Pro.

step-3.title: Step 3: futuretest and simulate
step-3.body: One war onset set against every one on record, then an event rule: its backtest from the next close, and the signal your AI can read.

step-bonus.title: Lesson 7: team and the model
step-bonus.body: Pin a backtest where three seats read the same numbers, then see how filed statements become a discounted cash flow and a spreadsheet. The model is drawn as a schematic with no figures.
